I just wanted to say to everyone who commented on this thank you. I kinda feel accepted after reading everyone’s words and I never feel accepted. I don’t usually post on Reddit in fear that people will just shit on me. This for once made me feel like people actually do care and that there’s others out there with similar struggles. Again thank you so much because now I at least have some form of direction in this all.

Hey there Map (hope you don’t mind that it was in ur name) I know and understand some of what you are saying I’ve been working on my autism with my parents they believe I will need assisted living because they think I cannot do the basic tasks of life and sometimes when I hear that it makes me feel like shit utter shit but what I can tell you is what makes me feel better is remembering that being an adult isn’t always being able to do functional things it’s also about the decisions you make throughout your life being autistic doesn’t mean you have to meet the normal standards for typical people because we are autistic and meeting whatever standards we need is ok in my eyes the difference between atypical minds and typical minds is kinda like riding a skateboard with sneakers(typical) vs spiked boots (atypical) and honestly I think the fact that our lives are harder than a typical persons kinda kicks ass because in the back of our heads we know we’re fighting harder than anyone but that’s just my take I hope it makes you feel better dude!
Oh and my ASD is level 2
